description: This file defines an interface for reading dropdown options related to savings in the Fineract project, including various interest and lock-in period options.

classes.name: SavingsDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface that declares methods to retrieve collection of EnumOptionData representing various dropdown options related to savings account configurations.

methods.name: retrieveLockinPeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns collection of EnumOptionData for lock-in period frequency types.

methods.name: retrieveCompoundingInterestPeriodTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns collection of EnumOptionData for compounding interest period types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPostingPeriodTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns collection of EnumOptionData for interest posting period types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestCalculationTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns collection of EnumOptionData for interest calculation types.

methods.name: retrieveInterestCalculationDaysInYearTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns collection of EnumOptionData for days-in-year types used in interest calculation.

methods.name: retrievewithdrawalFeeTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns collection of EnumOptionData for withdrawal fee types.
